output.level_0: The serving endpoint crashes nightly, forcing every store to order blind from last week's paper sheets.
output.level_1: No serving endpoint exists, so buyers manually copy forecast numbers into spreadsheets before the morning window.
output.level_2: A junior engineer manually pushes forecast files to the ordering system every morning before the window opens.
output.level_3: The endpoint automatically serves fresh forecasts to the ordering system and store app during the morning window.
